_meta.description: Pick your iPhone and download a door for the Afterglow viewer: one PETG print with no TPU, the camera opening cut for your phone, and MagSafe placed over its magnets.
a-front-stop-for.5299c6: A front stop for every size
a-groove-for-a.94b18d: A groove for a stick-on steel ring, centred over this phone's magnets. MagSafe accessories then hold on from outside the door.
a-plain-door-with.be8715: A plain door with the dot field running through the middle.
a-round-opening-over.491df0: A round opening over the magnets, so a magnetic cooler can touch the phone directly.
check-that-the-clips.e1739f: Check that the clips, 14 to 25 mm from each end of the phone, miss your phone's buttons.
check-the-camera-numbers.a2010e: Check the camera numbers: sizes must be above 0 and nothing can be negative.
door-frame-from-brenpoly.3ea4f4: Door frame from brenpoly's CardboardXR door generator, Apache 2.0. The shell is a remix of brenpoly's viewer, CC BY-NC-SA. Phone dimensions from Apple's dimensional drawings. iPhone and MagSafe are trademarks of Apple Inc. See notices.
every-door-here-is.4ac82d: Every door here is checked against the shell's CAD for overlaps. The iPhone 18 Pro Max door shares the design that has been printed. The clips on the smaller phones haven't been printed yet, so try the fit gently on your first one. Print the shell from MakerWorld.
every-position-comes-from.632cc3: Every position comes from Apple's drawing for that phone. It isn't always the middle: on the iPhone 17 Pro and 18 Pro the magnets sit 2.7 mm toward the USB end.
everything-runs-in-your.c66f5a: Everything runs in your browser. Nothing is uploaded.
fill-in-every-size.c587a7: Fill in every size to build a door.
fix-the-values-above.0872a2: Fix the values above to build a door.
hang-the-door-on.3342ac: Hang the door on the shell with its hinge pin and close it with a hair tie, as usual.
measure-your-phone-with.ca71b8: Measure your phone with calipers, or read the numbers from Apple's dimensional drawing. All sizes are in millimetres.
on-a-clipped-door.c1bf71: On a clipped door, press the phone in screen up until all four clips catch. To take it out, push through the dots from the back.
on-a-phone-this.45fa96: On a phone this thin, the ring sits {v} mm below the door's outer face so it stays close to the magnets.
part-of-this-door.08b59f: Part of this door came out in more than one piece, so it can't be printed. Check the camera and MagSafe numbers.
pick-your-iphone-and.a833b0: Pick your iPhone and download its door. One print in PETG, no TPU, with the camera opening and MagSafe placed for your phone.
print-in-petg-outer.88738a: Print in PETG, outer face down, exactly as the file is oriented. No supports.
pro-max-phones-seat.6b4fbd: Pro Max phones seat on the shell's screen shelves. Smaller Pro phones pass inside those shelves, so their doors add four rigid clips that hold the edge of the glass.
raised-camera-area-from.b90556: Raised camera area, from the back, camera end up
rigid-anchors-printed-into.3747e5: Rigid anchors printed into the door locate the phone at each corner. There are no soft bumpers to print, change filament for or lose.
something-went-wrong-while.dc2e0b: Something went wrong while building the door.
that-magsafe-position-runs.93a68c: That MagSafe position runs past the edge of the door.
the-3d-preview-needs.70028e: The 3D preview needs WebGL. You can still download your door below.
the-camera-area-runs.9fe645: The camera area runs past the edge of the phone. Check its numbers.
the-corner-radius-has.008ac9: The corner radius has to be between {min} and {max} mm.
these-doors-fit-the.0e35af: These doors fit the Afterglow remix, 7 mm wider and 12 mm longer than the original viewer. They use its hinge and latch, and they won't fit the original shell.
this-shell-takes-phones.06b9ed: This shell takes phones up to {w} × {l} mm and {t} mm thick.
use-a-0-2.5cd08b: Use a 0.2 mm layer or finer so the MagSafe groove comes out clean.
v-mm-is-too.2ab29a: {v} mm is too thin: the door takes phones at least {min} mm thick.
v-mm-is-too.31188d: {v} mm is too wide: this shell takes phones up to {max} mm wide.
v-mm-is-too.577b7e: {v} mm is too long: this shell takes phones up to {max} mm long.
v-mm-is-too.9bc8ca: {v} mm is too short: the clips reach phones at least {min} mm long.
v-mm-is-too.a817d6: {v} mm is too thick: the door takes phones up to {max} mm, without the camera.
v-mm-is-too.fe35c3: {v} mm is too narrow: the clips reach phones at least {min} mm wide.
